Recorded claim:
Cover disabled, disabled-hover and checked-disabled menu states explicitly. Only deemphasize enabled accelerator text where normal contrast permits it. Entry295 fixed these combinations; current rewritten CSS retains explicit disabled states but uses --text-color-disabled instead of the historical token. Do not hardcode an obsolete theme variable from the old diff.

title: Recorded lesson: Disabled menu states and high contrast need separate styling checks
